title: Gravitas finding record
description: One claim returned by a finder, reader or scout. A list of these is what scripts/ledger.py add expects.

claim.description: One falsifiable statement, in a full sentence.

location.description: Where it applies: file:line, URL, statute section, spreadsheet cell, page, slide or timestamp.

tier.description: What happened during this work to establish the claim.

source.description: What produced the tier: the artifact inspected, the command and its result, or the URL or path with the quoted line. Empty only for inferred.

dimension.description: The angle or lens that found it, e.g. security, contract, rendering, citation.

hypothesis.description: True when the claim is inferred and has no independent check yet.

falsifier.description: What observation would show the claim is wrong.

key.description: Optional stable deduplication key. The ledger computes one from location and claim when absent.
